head: syġ (< MEA swg cf. SL 975: to block up; to shut in, enclose; to hinder, impede; 571;)

examples.turoyo: ono səġli aq qayse lu saṯwo, yaʕni qṭiʕili, maḥtili ʕal ḥḏoḏe aw bi ṣira
examples.translation: I organized pieces of wood for the winter, that is, I cut them, put them on each other or in a row
examples.raw: ono səġli aq qayse lu saṯwo, yaʕni qṭiʕili, maḥtili ʕal ḥḏoḏe aw bi ṣira 'I organized pieces of wood for the winter, that is, I cut them, put them on each other or in a row' (AA)

examples.turoyo: … ḥǝmyoni u aḥuno Ṣaliba sayġiwa i goro d ʕito.
examples.translation: My father in-law and brother Saliba were making a fence on the church roof.
examples.raw: … ḥǝmyoni u aḥuno Ṣaliba sayġiwa i goro d ʕito. ‘My father in-law and brother Saliba were making a fence on the church roof.’                                   2018_07_08_au_003_NE_1F; 25:29
